units.name: Classical Indian Philosophy
schools: Vedānta (Advaita, Viśiṣṭādvaita, Dvaita, Dvaitādvaita, Śuddhādvaita, Acintyabhedābheda)

units.name: Classical Western Philosophy
schools: Platonic Idealism (Forms, Divided Line, Allegory of Cave, Soul)

units.name: Modern Western Philosophy
schools: Critical Idealism (Kant's Critique of Pure Reason, Synthetic A Priori, Antinomies)
German Idealism (Hegel's Dialectical Method, Absolute Spirit)

units.name: Contemporary Western Philosophy
schools: Early & Late Analytic Philosophy (Frege, Russell, Wittgenstein)

units.name: Contemporary Indian Philosophy
schools: Sri Aurobindo (Involution, Evolution, Integral Yoga, Supermind)
M. K. Gandhi (Satyāgraha, Ahiṃsā, Sarvodaya, Swaraj)
Dr. B. R. Ambedkar (Neo-Buddhism/Navayāna, Critique of Caste, Liberty-Equality-Fraternity)
K. C. Bhattacharyya (Swaraj in Ideas, The Subject as Freedom)
Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan (An Idealist View of Life, Intellect vs Intuition)
J. Krishnamurti (Freedom from the Known, Choiceless Awareness)

units.name: Comparative Epistemology, Logic & Ethics
schools: Pramāṇa Theory & Theories of Truth (Svataḥ vs Parataḥ Prāmāṇya)
Khyātivāda (Theories of Error in Indian Philosophy)
Normative Ethics & Meta-ethics (Deontology, Utilitarianism, Virtue, Puruṣārthas, Niṣkāma Karma)
Social Justice & Political Philosophy (Rawls, Nozick, Ambedkar, Sen)
